newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Rao charged by court in cheating case.
newsitem.headline: India's Rao charged by court in cheating case.

text.p: A Delhi court on Wednesday formally charged former Indian prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao with criminal conspiracy for his alleged involvement in a 1983 cheating case.
"I find prime facie evidence against Mr Rao. So I am framing the charges of cheating and criminal conspiracy," trial court judge Ajit Bharihoke told a packed courtroom.
Bharihoke's order was the third formal charge against the former prime minister whose Congress party, weakened by a series of scandals, suffered its worst-ever election debacle this year.
Rao did not go to the witness box. The charge papers were brought to him by a court official who asked: "Do you plead guilty or not?"
Rao replied: "No, I claim to be tried."
Bharihoke said his court was also charging Hindu guru Chandraswami, whom Rao has acknowledged as a long-term acquaintance, and Chandraswami's assistant K.N. Agarwal. Both have pleaded not guilty.

The cheating case involves expatriate Indian businessman Lakhubhai Pathak, who claimed he paid $100,000 to Chandraswami in an unsuccessful attempt to win a government newsprint contract after Rao, then foreign minister, assured him at a meeting in a New York hotel that he would get the contract.
Rao has said he is innocent in the case, and has denied he was in New York at the time of the alleged meeting. If convicted, he faces a possible prison sentence of seven years.
Rao applied for bail to protect himself from being taken into custody as a result of the charges laid on Wednesday, his lawyer, R.K. Anand, told Reuters.
"We had arguments in the office and I have put in the bail application and I am waiting for orders at 3 p.m. (0930 GMT)," he said.
The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) opposed Rao's bail application out of fear that releasing Rao could lead to evidence-tampering, court officials said.
The other cases in which Rao has been charged involve alleged forgery and vote-buying.
